kicker: Gated Oyster Bay · Fernandina Beach, Florida
title: 96133 Oyster Bay Drive
description: Luxury living in gated Oyster Bay. Twelve-foot ceilings and hickory floors run through a light-filled great room with gas fireplace, built-ins, and wet bar, opening to a chef's kitchen with quartz counters and an oversized island. Two first-floor ensuite bedrooms — including the primary suite — make it ideal for multigenerational living, and every bedroom has its own bath. Triple sliders lead to a screened lanai overlooking a fenced yard with fruit trees and peaceful lagoon views.
